observable_definition.reported_source_coordinate: paper coordinate has expected redshift gradient negative along its plotted z axis
observable_definition.cr006_canonical_observable: upper clock fractional frequency minus lower clock fractional frequency per 1 mm upward separation
observable_definition.measurement_reveal_conversion: multiply the paper's final reported gradient by -1 when converting to upper-minus-lower per positive upward height

local_gravitational_acceleration_m_s2.source: Bothwell et al. paper Methods, NGS evaluated local laboratory acceleration rounded to 4 digits

canonical_calculation_lock.A0_rule: A0 is a common floor and is canceled before forming the endpoint observable

uncertainty_method.primary_sigma: experiment's final reported total uncertainty after measurement reveal
uncertainty_method.input_sigma: local acceleration rounding bound propagated as optional negligible input uncertainty

verdict_thresholds.PASS: |z| <= 2 and WC1-WC6 fail materially by magnitude or channel rule; WC7 is diagnostic only
verdict_thresholds.FAIL: |z| > 3, canonical sign/channel wrong, local A0 required, or fitted normalization required
verdict_thresholds.BOUNDARY: 2 < |z| <= 3 or public geometry insufficient for clean independent calculation

exact_weak_consistency_gate.basis: well above the computed expansion-order difference and far below the observed uncertainty

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Add the floor locally
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: fails if any uncanceled A0 local contribution is required or if magnitude is grossly inconsistent

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Remove the half factor
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: fails materially if |z| > 3 or if it doubles the endpoint clock coefficient

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Use 1/r^2 as the clock field
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: fails materially if |z| > 3 or if it changes the endpoint field dependence

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Reverse endpoint order
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: fails if the sign reverses relative to the frozen upper-minus-lower observable

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Use photon-road integration
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.formula: wrong = (1/c) * integral_lower_to_upper A ds approximated by A_lower*h/c
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: fails by channel and units because a road time integral is not an endpoint clock fraction

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Free clock normalization
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.formula: wrong fits k = observed/weak after reveal
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: rejected as noncanonical because it introduces one free parameter

wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.name: Newtonian near-surface approximation only
wrong_controls_locked_before_reveal.break_condition: not a wrong-physics failure; must agree as the near-surface limit and must not replace the A-kernel route
